In this checkout I can't find a justfile, so I can't confirm what `just test` runs or whether it has a fast variant. The Makefile is also still here, so the removal may not be on this branch yet.

The old Makefile's fast target ran this, and you can run it directly:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

It skips the Postgres-marked tests, so it needs no database. The full suite, `pytest -q`, needs `docker compose up db` first.

If your justfile has a fast recipe, it probably wraps the same command. `just --list` will show the recipe names. If you want, I can add a `test-fast` recipe once the justfile is in.

An EngramDB memory in this project still says to use `make test-fast`. I haven't changed it, because the Makefile still exists here. Once the removal lands, it should be updated to the new command.
